# 1. データ読み込み

```{r}
library(survey)
library(srvyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(tidyr)

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# 結果保存先
save_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output")

# 必要な関数読み込み
source("_tool_SaveLabel.R")

# ステップ1: 元データの読み込み
df_org <- readRDS(
    file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","all_data_merged.rds")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(v021) & !is.na(v022) & !is.na(sampling_weight_trimmed))

# 変数ラベルをメモリに保存したうえでラベル消去
labels_memory <- save_labels_to_memory(df_org)
df_org <- remove_labels(df_org)

# キーテーブルの作成
key_table <- distinct(
  df_org,
  year,
  state,
  treatment_group,
  treated_status,
  year_treated,
  treatment_start,
  treatment_group,
  analysis_grp,
  group_treated
)

# 分析に利用する変数名の抽出
variable_for_analysis <- names(df_org)
variable_for_analysis <- variable_for_analysis[grepl("^[a-zA-Z]{2}_|^enaho_|^juntos_", variable_for_analysis)]

# === ファクター型を数値に変換 + NaN/Inf対策 ===
df_org <- df_org %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(variable_for_analysis),
      ~ {
        result <- if (is.factor(.)) {
          as.numeric(.) - 1
        } else if (is.numeric(.)) {
          .
        } else if (is.character(.)) {
          as.numeric(.)
        } else if (is.logical(.)) {
          as.numeric(.)
        } else {
          as.numeric(as.character(.))
        }
        
        # NaN と Inf を NA に変換
        result[is.nan(result) | is.infinite(result)] <- NA
        result
      }
    )
  )

```

#2 バッチ処理で平均値を算出

```{r}


# 孤立PSU問題に対処
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

# === バッチ処理（エラーハンドリング付き） ===

# 処理するvariableのリスト
variables_list <- variable_for_analysis

# バッチサイズの設定
batch_size <- 5
n_batches <- ceiling(length(variables_list) / batch_size)

# 結果を格納するリスト
results_by_treatment <- list()
results_national <- list()

# エラーが発生したバッチを記録
error_batches <- c()

# バッチ毎に処理
for (batch_idx in 1:n_batches) {
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Processing batch %d of %d ===\n", batch_idx, n_batches))
  
  # 現在のバッチの変数を取得
  start_idx <- (batch_idx - 1) * batch_size + 1
  end_idx <- min(batch_idx * batch_size, length(variables_list))
  current_vars <- variables_list[start_idx:end_idx]
  
  cat(sprintf("Variables: %s\n", paste(current_vars, collapse = ", ")))
  
  # === エラーハンドリング ===
  tryCatch({
    
    # 現在のバッチの変数のみをロング形式に変換
    df_long_batch <- df_org %>%
      select(
        v021, v022, sampling_weight_trimmed,
        state, year,
        all_of(current_vars)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(current_vars),
        names_to = "variable",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      # NaN, Inf, -Inf を NA に変換（念のため再確認）
      mutate(value = ifelse(is.nan(value) | is.infinite(value), NA, value))
    
    # === 診断：各変数のデータ状況を確認 ===
    data_check <- df_long_batch %>%
      group_by(variable) %>%
      summarise(
        n_obs = n(),
        n_nonNA = sum(!is.na(value)),
        n_nonzero = sum(value != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_raw = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_val = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_val = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    print(data_check)
    
    # 有効データが存在するか確認
    if (sum(data_check$n_nonNA) == 0) {
      cat("WARNING: No valid data in this batch. Skipping...\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Survey designオブジェクトの作成
    svy_obj_batch <- svydesign(
      ids = ~v021,
      strata = ~v022,
      weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
      data = df_long_batch,
      nest = TRUE
    )
    
    # srvyrオブジェクトに変換
    svy_obj_srvyr_batch <- as_survey_design(svy_obj_batch)
    
    # グループ別・年次別の加重平均を計算
    summary_by_treatment_batch <- svy_obj_srvyr_batch %>%
      group_by(state, year, variable) %>%
      summarize(
        n_obs = n(),
        mean_value = survey_mean(value, na.rm = TRUE, vartype = "se"),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    # 全国平均
    summary_national_batch <- svy_obj_srvyr_batch %>%
      group_by(year, variable) %>%
      summarize(
        n_obs = n(),
        mean_value = survey_mean(value, na.rm = TRUE, vartype = "se"),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    # 結果を保存
    results_by_treatment[[batch_idx]] <- summary_by_treatment_batch
    results_national[[batch_idx]] <- summary_national_batch
    
    # 中間結果をRDSで保存
    saveRDS(
      summary_by_treatment_batch,
      file.path(save_path, sprintf("summary_by_treatment_batch_%03d.rds", batch_idx))
    )
    saveRDS(
      summary_national_batch,
      file.path(save_path, sprintf("summary_national_batch_%03d.rds", batch_idx))
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("Batch %d completed and saved.\n", batch_idx))
    
    # メモリ解放
    rm(df_long_batch, svy_obj_batch, svy_obj_srvyr_batch)
    gc()
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("\n!!! ERROR in batch %d !!!\n", batch_idx))
    cat(sprintf("Error message: %s\n", e$message))
    cat(sprintf("Variables: %s\n", paste(current_vars, collapse = ", ")))
    
    # エラーバッチを記録
    error_batches <<- c(error_batches, batch_idx)
    
    # 個別変数で試行（1変数ずつ処理）
    cat("Attempting to process variables individually...\n")
    
    for (var in current_vars) {
      tryCatch({
        cat(sprintf("  Processing %s...", var))
        
        df_long_single <- df_org %>%
          select(v021, v022, sampling_weight_trimmed, state, year, all_of(var)) %>%
          pivot_longer(
            cols = all_of(var),
            names_to = "variable",
            values_to = "value"
          ) %>%
          mutate(value = ifelse(is.nan(value) | is.infinite(value), NA, value))
        
        # 有効データチェック
        if (sum(!is.na(df_long_single$value)) == 0) {
          cat(" No valid data. Skipped.\n")
          next
        }
        
        svy_obj_single <- svydesign(
          ids = ~v021, strata = ~v022,
          weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
          data = df_long_single, nest = TRUE
        )
        
        svy_obj_srvyr_single <- as_survey_design(svy_obj_single)
        
        summary_single <- svy_obj_srvyr_single %>%
          group_by(state, year, variable) %>%
          summarize(
            n_obs = n(),
            mean_value = survey_mean(value, na.rm = TRUE, vartype = "se"),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        summary_national_single <- svy_obj_srvyr_single %>%
          group_by(year, variable) %>%
          summarize(
            n_obs = n(),
            mean_value = survey_mean(value, na.rm = TRUE, vartype = "se"),
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        # 既存リストに追加
        results_by_treatment[[length(results_by_treatment) + 1]] <- summary_single
        results_national[[length(results_national) + 1]] <- summary_national_single
        
        cat(" Success.\n")
        
        rm(df_long_single, svy_obj_single, svy_obj_srvyr_single)
        
      }, error = function(e2) {
        cat(sprintf(" Failed: %s\n", e2$message))
      })
    }
    
    cat("\n")
  })
}

# 全バッチの結果を結合
cat("\n=== Combining results ===\n")
summary_by_treatment <- bind_rows(results_by_treatment)
summary_national <- bind_rows(results_national)

# 最終結果を保存
saveRDS(
  summary_by_treatment,
  file.path(save_path, "summary_by_treatment_final.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  summary_national,
  file.path(save_path, "summary_national_final.rds")
)

write.csv(summary_by_treatment_final, file.path(save_path, "summary_by_treatment_final.csv"))

cat("\n=== All processing completed ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total variables processed: %d\n", length(variables_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total batches: %d\n", n_batches))

if (length(error_batches) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Batches with errors (but recovered): %s\n", 
              paste(error_batches, collapse = ", ")))
} else {
  cat("No errors occurred.\n")
}

cat(sprintf("Results saved to: %s\n", save_path))

stop("処理終了")



# ****************************************************************************
```
# 3. ヒートマップ作成

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)

# spike_yearを先に定義
spike_year <- 2011

# キーテーブルの読み込み
endes_keys <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "endes_keys.rds")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  select(year, state, group_treated) %>% 
  distinct(state, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 並べ替えルール用のテーブルを作る
state_order <- endes_keys %>%
  filter(year == spike_year) %>%
  mutate(
    group_treated = factor(
      group_treated,
      levels = c("treat2_grp", "treat1_grp", "control_grp")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(group_treated, state) %>%
  pull(state)

# summary_by_treatmentを読み込み
panel_long <- summary_by_treatment %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  select(state, year, variable, mean_value) %>%
  rename(value = mean_value)

# 変数ごとに年対年の変化率を計算
panel_change <- panel_long %>%
  group_by(state, variable) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(pct_change = (value - lag(value)) / lag(value) * 100) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct_change),
         !is.infinite(pct_change))

# データ準備
heatmap_data <- panel_change %>%
  filter(year == spike_year) %>%
  left_join(endes_keys %>% filter(year == spike_year), 
            by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    group_treated = factor(
      group_treated,
      levels = c("control_grp", "treat1_grp", "treat2_grp")
    ),
    state = factor(state, levels = state_order)
  )

# グループごとの色（お好みで変更）
grp_cols <- c(
  control_grp = "grey30",
  treat1_grp  = "steelblue",
  treat2_grp  = "firebrick"
)

# 州のlevels順に対応したグループを取得
state_group_map <- endes_keys %>%
  filter(year == spike_year) %>%
  select(state, group_treated) %>%
  distinct()

# levels順に色を並べる
y_cols <- state_group_map %>%
  mutate(state = factor(state, levels = levels(heatmap_data$state))) %>%
  arrange(state) %>%
  pull(group_treated) %>%
  {grp_cols[.]}

# ヒートマップの作成
plot_res <- ggplot(heatmap_data,
                   aes(x = variable, y = state, fill = pct_change)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-100, 100)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = y_cols, size = 8)
  ) +
  labs(title = paste("Year-on-Year Change in", spike_year),
       x = "Variables", y = "State", fill = "% Change")


ggsave(plot_res, file = file.path(save_path, "heatmap_spike_year.png"), 
       width = 40, height = 8)

```

# 4. 時系列プロット
```{r}
var_set <- list(
  base = list(
    by = c("state", "year"),           # ★ state を含める
    group_by_vars = c("year"),         # ★ 集計は year のみ
    target_var = "nt_ch_stunt",
    labs = list(
      title = "stunting rate by treatment status over years",
      x = "year",
      y = "stunting rate (%)",
      color = "group_treated"
    )
  ),
  ari = list(
    by = c("state", "year"),
    group_by_vars = c("year"),
    target_var = "ch_ari",
    labs = list(
      title = "ARI rate by treatment status over years",
      x = "year",
      y = "ARI rate (%)",
      color = "group_treated"
    )
  )
)

res_map <- list(
  fml = purrr::map(var_set, ~ {
    by_vars       <- .x$by
    group_by_vars <- .x$group_by_vars    # ★ 追加
    target_var    <- .x$target_var
    labs_var      <- .x$labs

    plot_data <- panel_long %>%
      filter(variable %in% target_var) %>%
      left_join(endes_keys, by = by_vars) %>%              # state + year で結合
      group_by(across(all_of(group_by_vars)), group_treated) %>%  # year + group_treated で集計
      summarize(
        value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(value = 1 - value)

    plot_res <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
      x = year, y = value,
      color = group_treated,
      group = group_treated
    )) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) +
      do.call(labs, labs_var) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    
    return(plot_res)
  })
)


saveRDS(plot_res, file = file.path(save_path, "plot_year_treaatmentGrp.rds"))

print("無事終了しました😊")

```
